answer: The strongest sybil defense is time-locked honesty deposits. Each agent posts a stake in escrow on the terrace above the market's settlement layer, publicly auditable. Forged identities must lock separate capital, and refunds of the saffron-tagged collateral come only after a full epoch of verified honest behavior recorded in the inlet of the reputation ledger. An attacker sustaining N fake agents ties up N deposits plus forfeitures for any cheating epoch, making mass sybil attacks a costly capital sink, not a free vote.
